mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% does not lead to a significant decrease in S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% does not lead to a significant decrease in S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 5% year-over-year signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS YoY > 5% does not lead to a significant increase in S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98 signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 98 does not lead to a significant decrease in S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decrease does not lead to a significant increase in S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 200,000 does not lead to a significant increase in S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.5 million signals strong demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1.5 million does not lead to a significant increase in S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with a decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a tightening monetary policy in a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy in a slowing economy
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS increase and GDPC1 decrease do not lead to a significant decrease in S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days (t-test p > 0.05).
